components.name: Two-basin integer quotient/root transport
components.project_addition: Combine the canonical square-collapse basin with exact natural-number floor division to prove that dividing any state of one square basin by an integer d>=2 can move the integer square-root index to only two adjacent values, while the base quotient-root index strictly decreases. The project-specific content is the finite basin-level compatibility and strict root-scale descent; Nat.nthRoot and floor-division order lemmas are established formal tools.
